vocab.definition: feeling upset
vocab.example: Because Jane does not listen to her, Jane’s mom is angry.
vocab.cn_example: 因为简不听她的话，简的妈妈很生气。

vocab.definition: not interesting
vocab.example: Jason hates staying inside because it is so boring.
vocab.cn_example: 杰森讨厌待在室内，因为太无聊了。

vocab.definition: a lesson at school
vocab.example: Ryan’s dad teaches a new class.
vocab.cn_example: 瑞安的爸爸教一门新课。

vocab.definition: to think about a wish for something good
vocab.cn_meaning: 想象对美好事物的愿望
vocab.example: She dreams about living in the city.
vocab.cn_example: 她梦想着住在城市里。

vocab.definition: known by many people
vocab.example: The kids like the famous baseball player.
vocab.cn_example: 孩子们喜欢那位著名的棒球运动员。

vocab.definition: to have a sense of something
vocab.example: He felt very hot after walking for half the morning.
vocab.cn_example: 走了半个上午后，他觉得非常热。

vocab.definition: the time that has not happened yet
vocab.example: In the future, we will not need roads for driving.
vocab.cn_example: 在未来，我们将不需要道路来开车。

vocab.definition: several people that are together
vocab.example: The group uses a large table to study.
vocab.cn_example: 这个小组用一张大桌子来学习。

vocab.definition: something you like to do in your free time
vocab.example: Her hobbies are drawing and painting.
vocab.cn_example: 她的爱好是画画和绘画。

vocab.definition: the work that a person is paid to do
vocab.example: She needs money, so she wants to get a job.
vocab.cn_example: 她需要钱，所以她想找一份工作。

vocab.definition: the number 100
vocab.example: Five hundred dollars is a lot of money.
vocab.cn_example: 五百美元是一大笔钱。

vocab.definition: to ask to go somewhere
vocab.example: Mrs. Jones invited us into her home.
vocab.cn_example: 琼斯夫人邀请我们到她家里。

vocab.definition: the study of numbers
vocab.example: The boy is good at math.
vocab.cn_example: 这个男孩擅长数学。

vocab.definition: a picture taken with a camera
vocab.example: I am glad you shared these photos with me.
vocab.cn_example: 我很高兴你和我分享了这些照片。

vocab.definition: the leader of the government or of a company
vocab.example: Many kids dream about becoming their country’s president.
vocab.cn_example: 许多孩子梦想成为他们国家的总统。

vocab.definition: very
vocab.example: This TV show is really good.
vocab.cn_example: 这个电视节目真的很好。

vocab.definition: a talk that someone gives in front of a group of people
vocab.cn_meaning: 在一群人面前发表的讲话
vocab.example: The woman answered a lot of questions during her speech.
vocab.cn_example: 那位女士在演讲中回答了许多问题。

vocab.definition: to go on a trip, usually far away
vocab.example: Vicky loves to travel. She goes to many faraway places.
vocab.cn_example: 薇姬喜欢旅行。她去过很多遥远的地方。

vocab.definition: the sound a person makes when speaking or singing
vocab.cn_meaning: 人说话或唱歌时发出的声音
vocab.example: Janet has a beautiful voice. She should give singing lessons.
vocab.cn_example: 珍妮特的声音很美。她应该教唱歌课。

vocab.definition: to have interest in knowing or learning something
vocab.cn_meaning: 对知道或了解某事有兴趣
vocab.example: Carlos did not bring a pencil to class today. I wonder why.
vocab.cn_example: 卡洛斯今天没带铅笔来上课。我想知道为什么。

vocab.definition: a game in which players hit a ball with a bat
vocab.cn_meaning: 球员用球棒击球的运动
vocab.example: I really like to play baseball with my brother.
vocab.cn_example: 我很喜欢和哥哥一起打棒球。

vocab.definition: a game in which players throw a ball through a net
vocab.cn_meaning: 球员把球投入篮网的运动
vocab.example: I need new shoes for playing basketball.
vocab.cn_example: 我需要新鞋来打篮球。

vocab.definition: involving danger or harm
vocab.example: Going into the city alone can be dangerous.
vocab.cn_example: 一个人进城可能很危险。

vocab.definition: feeling happy about something
vocab.example: Lisa is excited to hear the president’s speech.
vocab.cn_example: 莉莎很兴奋能听到总统的演讲。

vocab.definition: land that is higher than the area around it
vocab.example: I wonder what is at the top of that hill.
vocab.cn_example: 我想知道那座小山的顶上有什么。

vocab.definition: to make contact with something quickly
vocab.example: Josh hit the ball with his bat.
vocab.cn_example: 乔希用球棒击中了球。

vocab.definition: the place people go when they are sick
vocab.example: The nurse at the hospital was nice to Janet.
vocab.cn_example: 医院的护士对珍妮特很好。

vocab.definition: to harm, wound, or damage
vocab.example: Max hurt his leg when he fell down during the game.
vocab.cn_example: 马克斯在比赛中摔倒时伤了腿。

vocab.definition: a bike that runs on a motor; a motorcycle
vocab.cn_meaning: 靠马达驱动的自行车；摩托车
vocab.example: Riding a motorbike is one of my hobbies.
vocab.cn_example: 骑摩托车是我的爱好之一。

vocab.definition: not fast
vocab.example: The snail is a slow animal.
vocab.cn_example: 蜗牛是一种行动缓慢的动物。

vocab.definition: to fall or let fall
vocab.example: Agnes dropped the ball.
vocab.cn_example: 阿格尼丝把球掉了。

vocab.definition: the ground; dirt
vocab.example: The earth here is perfect for growing things.
vocab.cn_example: 这里的泥土很适合种植东西。

vocab.definition: a shape, often with four sides, used as a symbol
vocab.cn_meaning: 一种形状，通常有四条边，用作标志
vocab.example: This flag shows the race is over.
vocab.cn_example: 这面旗子表示比赛结束了。

vocab.definition: lacking wisdom; stupid
vocab.example: It was foolish to get close to the animal.
vocab.cn_example: 靠近那只动物是愚蠢的。

vocab.definition: to use hands to carry something
vocab.example: The lady is holding a bottle of water.
vocab.cn_example: 那位女士拿着一瓶水。

vocab.definition: to be important
vocab.example: It does not matter which doctor you see. They are all good.
vocab.cn_example: 你看哪个医生都无所谓。他们都很优秀。

vocab.definition: in the shape of a circle or ball
vocab.example: The colorful ball is round.
vocab.cn_example: 那个彩色的球是圆的。

vocab.definition: to move a person or thing from one place to another
vocab.cn_meaning: 把人或物从一个地方移到另一个地方
vocab.example: I am going to take my little brother to a game.
vocab.cn_example: 我要带我弟弟去看一场比赛。

vocab.definition: when two teams finish with the same number of points
vocab.cn_meaning: 两队以相同分数结束比赛
vocab.example: The game ended in a tie.
vocab.cn_example: 比赛以平局结束。

vocab.definition: what the air is like at a certain time and place
vocab.example: We did not have our baseball game because of bad weather.
vocab.cn_example: 因为天气不好，我们没有举行棒球比赛。

vocab.definition: paintings, drawings, or sculptures
vocab.example: One of my hobbies is making art for my parents.
vocab.cn_example: 我的爱好之一是为父母创作艺术品。

vocab.definition: to make
vocab.example: He dreams about building houses for a job.
vocab.cn_example: 他梦想以建房子为职业。

vocab.definition: to decide or make a choice
vocab.example: They are choosing which color they like.
vocab.cn_example: 他们正在选择自己喜欢的颜色。

vocab.definition: to make a picture using a pen or pencil
vocab.example: Martha is drawing a man walking with a flag.
vocab.cn_example: 玛莎正在画一个举着旗子行走的男人。

vocab.definition: a child
vocab.example: The kid in the math class did not understand the lesson.
vocab.cn_example: 数学课上的那个孩子没有听懂这节课。

vocab.definition: to make art with paint
vocab.example: In the future, she hopes to paint great art for a job.
vocab.cn_example: 在未来，她希望能以画伟大艺术品为职业。

vocab.definition: a photograph or other image of a person or thing
vocab.cn_meaning: 人或事物的照片或其他图像
vocab.example: These are pictures of my friends.
vocab.cn_example: 这些是我朋友的照片。

vocab.definition: a living thing that grows in the earth
vocab.example: There are many plants on this hill.
vocab.cn_example: 这座小山上有很多植物。

vocab.definition: to say again
vocab.example: Can you please repeat the question?
vocab.cn_example: 你能重复一下这个问题吗？

vocab.definition: one of the sides of a room
vocab.example: Does it matter what I put on my bedroom walls?
vocab.cn_example: 我在卧室墙上放什么重要吗？

vocab.definition: not in a place
vocab.example: Many students were absent because of bad weather.
vocab.cn_example: 因为天气不好，许多学生缺席了。

vocab.definition: the area farthest from the front
vocab.example: The people in the back of the room could not hear.
vocab.cn_example: 坐在房间后面的人听不到。

vocab.definition: to repair
vocab.example: Mike had to fix the window that his son broke.
vocab.cn_example: 迈克不得不修理他儿子打破的窗户。

vocab.definition: earth; ground
vocab.example: The land is really dry this year.
vocab.cn_example: 今年的土地非常干燥。

vocab.definition: clothes worn on the legs
vocab.example: Bring another pair of pants with you.
vocab.cn_example: 随身带另一条裤子吧。

vocab.definition: a meal eaten outside on the ground
vocab.example: They are having a picnic, and we are all invited.
vocab.cn_example: 他们在野餐，我们都被邀请了。

vocab.definition: a large flow of water moving across land
vocab.cn_meaning: 在陆地上流动的大片水流
vocab.example: Hundreds of people come to surf in this river every year.
vocab.cn_example: 每年有数百人来这条河冲浪。

vocab.definition: a big stone
vocab.example: Climbing rocks can be dangerous.
vocab.cn_example: 攀岩可能很危险。

vocab.definition: a place to go to learn
vocab.example: We sit on the stairs in front of our school.
vocab.cn_example: 我们坐在学校前面的台阶上。

vocab.definition: material from trees
vocab.example: They are using wood to build the house.
vocab.cn_example: 他们正在用木头建房子。

vocab.definition: sheets of paper held together
vocab.example: The book I am reading is about the future.
vocab.cn_example: 我正在读的这本书是关于未来的。

vocab.definition: a sample
vocab.example: This picture is an example of fine art.
vocab.cn_example: 这幅画是精美艺术的范例。

vocab.definition: something sticky used to make things stay together
vocab.cn_meaning: 用来把东西粘在一起的黏性物质
vocab.example: Rita fixed the picture with some glue.
vocab.cn_example: 丽塔用胶水修好了那幅画。

vocab.definition: a place where books are kept
vocab.example: The group did not have its meeting at the library today.
vocab.cn_example: 今天小组没有在图书馆开会。

vocab.definition: unkind
vocab.example: That animal is really mean.
vocab.cn_example: 那只动物真的很凶。

vocab.definition: a small part of something larger
vocab.example: The broken piece of glass is dangerous.
vocab.cn_example: 碎裂的玻璃片很危险。

vocab.definition: a way of doing or making something
vocab.cn_meaning: 做事或制造某物的方法
vocab.example: The president talked about his plan in the speech.
vocab.cn_example: 总统在演讲中谈到了他的计划。

vocab.definition: silent; making little sound
vocab.cn_meaning: 安静的；几乎没有声音的
vocab.example: It is important to be quiet in the library.
vocab.cn_example: 在图书馆保持安静很重要。

vocab.definition: to understand written words
vocab.example: We are reading about a famous basketball player.
vocab.cn_example: 我们正在读关于一位著名篮球运动员的内容。

vocab.definition: something you can hear
vocab.example: The river makes a loud sound when it rains.
vocab.cn_example: 下雨时河流发出很大的声音。

vocab.definition: right
vocab.example: The kid repeated the correct answer.
vocab.cn_example: 那个孩子重复了正确的答案。

vocab.definition: how two things are unlike each other
vocab.cn_meaning: 两件事物之间的不同之处
vocab.example: What is the difference between drawing and painting a picture?
vocab.cn_example: 画图和绘画有什么区别？

vocab.definition: not easy
vocab.example: The hill was both dangerous and difficult to climb.
vocab.cn_example: 那座小山既危险又难爬。

vocab.definition: very good
vocab.example: The weather is excellent today.
vocab.cn_example: 今天天气极好。

vocab.definition: to answer when you do not know if it is true
vocab.cn_meaning: 在不确定是否正确时回答
vocab.example: It is difficult to guess the right cup.
vocab.cn_example: 猜出正确的杯子很难。

vocab.definition: a place where items of art, science, or history are kept
vocab.cn_meaning: 存放艺术、科学或历史物品的地方
vocab.example: I like going to this museum because it is not boring.
vocab.cn_example: 我喜欢去这家博物馆，因为它不无聊。

vocab.definition: something you can hear, usually loud or unpleasant
vocab.cn_meaning: 你能听到的声音，通常很大或不悦
vocab.example: The angry man made a lot of noise.
vocab.cn_example: 那个生气的男人发出了很大的噪音。

vocab.definition: to rest
vocab.example: Try to relax during the weekend.
vocab.cn_example: 周末尽量放松一下。

vocab.definition: the study of things in the world
vocab.cn_meaning: 研究世界上的事物的学科
vocab.example: We studied the science of plants today.
vocab.cn_example: 今天我们学习了植物科学。

vocab.definition: on the day after today
vocab.example: Martin will be absent from school tomorrow.
vocab.cn_example: 马丁明天将缺席学校。

vocab.definition: near
vocab.example: The baby stays close to his mother.
vocab.cn_example: 婴儿待在妈妈身边。

vocab.definition: a plant that covers the ground
vocab.example: I enjoy relaxing on the grass.
vocab.cn_example: 我喜欢在草地上放松。

vocab.definition: something worn on the head
vocab.example: She wears her hat everywhere.
vocab.cn_example: 她到哪都戴着帽子。

vocab.definition: a large area of water with land around it
vocab.cn_meaning: 被陆地环绕的大片水域
vocab.example: We are having a picnic by the lake tomorrow.
vocab.cn_example: 我们明天要在湖边野餐。

vocab.definition: the round, white object in the sky at night
vocab.cn_meaning: 夜空中圆形的白色物体
vocab.example: What is the difference between the sun and the moon?
vocab.cn_example: 太阳和月亮有什么区别？

vocab.definition: a part of land that is higher than a hill
vocab.example: There is a river by the mountain.
vocab.cn_example: 山旁边有一条河。

vocab.definition: to be able to sense an odor with your nose
vocab.example: She is able to smell the beautiful flower.
vocab.cn_example: 她能闻到那朵美丽的花的香味。

vocab.definition: something used with water to clean
vocab.cn_meaning: 配合水用来清洁的东西
vocab.example: The kid used soap to wash his hands.
vocab.cn_example: 那个孩子用肥皂洗手。

vocab.definition: a seat in a bathroom
vocab.example: I do not like using the toilets at school.
vocab.cn_example: 我不喜欢用学校的厕所。

vocab.definition: covered with water
vocab.example: The boy got wet from the water.
vocab.cn_example: 男孩被水弄湿了。

vocab.definition: a type of shoe
vocab.example: I found an excellent pair of boots.
vocab.cn_example: 我找到了一双极好的靴子。

vocab.definition: going far below
vocab.example: They made a deep hole into the side of the hill.
vocab.cn_example: 他们在山坡上挖了一个深洞。

vocab.definition: land used for growing plants or raising animals for food
vocab.cn_meaning: 用于种植植物或饲养动物以获取食物的土地
vocab.example: Our plan is to visit a farm tomorrow.
vocab.cn_example: 我们的计划是明天去参观一个农场。

vocab.definition: clothing worn on the hands
vocab.example: You should wear gloves when working with wood.
vocab.cn_example: 做木工活时你应该戴手套。

vocab.definition: a building where people live
vocab.example: Will you repeat the directions to your house?
vocab.cn_example: 你能重复一下去你家的路线吗？

vocab.definition: having lots of sun
vocab.example: I guess it will be sunny tomorrow.
vocab.cn_example: 我猜明天会是晴天。

vocab.definition: the highest point
vocab.example: The man ran to the top of the hill.
vocab.cn_example: 那个男人跑到了小山顶上。

vocab.definition: a deep hole with water for drinking
vocab.example: The farm has a well where people take water to use.
vocab.cn_example: 农场有一口井，人们从那里取水使用。

vocab.definition: having a large distance from one side to the other
vocab.cn_meaning: 从一侧到另一侧距离很大的
vocab.example: The river is too wide to swim across.
vocab.cn_example: 这条河太宽了，游不过去。

vocab.definition: having a lot of wind
vocab.example: It is too windy to wear a hat today.
vocab.cn_example: 今天风太大了，不适合戴帽子。

vocab.definition: to look after
vocab.example: She cares for her puppy.
vocab.cn_example: 她照顾她的小狗。

vocab.definition: to stop living
vocab.example: The grass in the yard died in the winter.
vocab.cn_example: 院子里的草在冬天枯死了。

vocab.definition: having nothing inside
vocab.example: The pool is empty. It does not have water.
vocab.cn_example: 游泳池是空的。里面没有水。

vocab.definition: to give someone or something food
vocab.example: We cannot feed the animals in the mountains.
vocab.cn_example: 我们不能喂山里的动物。

vocab.definition: the good condition of the body
vocab.example: For your health, use soap to clean your body.
vocab.cn_example: 为了你的健康，用肥皂清洁身体。

vocab.definition: the body part that moves blood through the body
vocab.cn_meaning: 在身体中推动血液流动的身体器官
vocab.example: We are learning about how the heart works in science class.
vocab.cn_example: 我们在科学课上学习心脏是如何工作的。

vocab.definition: big in size or amount
vocab.example: Our house is very large and close to a beautiful lake.
vocab.cn_example: 我们的房子很大，靠近一个美丽的湖。

vocab.definition: to have or keep something in mind
vocab.example: He could not remember how to get to the farm.
vocab.cn_example: 他记不起怎么去农场了。

vocab.definition: something that says what you can or cannot do
vocab.cn_meaning: 规定你能做什么或不能做什么的东西
vocab.example: One of the library rules is, “Be quiet.”
vocab.cn_example: 图书馆的规则之一是“保持安静”。

vocab.definition: a place with wild animals for people to look at
vocab.cn_meaning: 供人们观赏野生动物的地方
vocab.example: Our school visited a museum and the zoo this year.
vocab.cn_example: 我们学校今年参观了博物馆和动物园。

vocab.definition: not clean
vocab.example: Wash that dirty toilet with soap and water.
vocab.cn_example: 用肥皂和水清洗那个脏马桶。

vocab.definition: to make full of something
vocab.example: Fill these empty bookshelves with your books.
vocab.cn_example: 用你的书填满这些空书架。

vocab.definition: recently made or gotten
vocab.example: I make a fresh cup of tea every morning.
vocab.cn_example: 我每天早上泡一杯新茶。

vocab.definition: a small green animal that lives near water
vocab.cn_meaning: 生活在水边的绿色小动物
vocab.example: A lot of frogs live by this lake.
vocab.cn_example: 这个湖边住着很多青蛙。

vocab.definition: a kid who is not a boy
vocab.example: There is a mean girl in my art class.
vocab.cn_example: 我的美术课上有一个不友善的女孩。

vocab.definition: a container used for drinks
vocab.example: Use this glass for your juice.
vocab.cn_example: 用这个杯子装你的果汁。

vocab.definition: needing food
vocab.example: The boy is hungry and ready to eat.
vocab.cn_example: 男孩饿了，准备吃东西。

vocab.definition: a tool used for eating
vocab.example: The baby uses a spoon to feed himself.
vocab.cn_example: 婴儿用勺子喂自己吃东西。

vocab.definition: needing to drink
vocab.example: Did you remember to bring water so you are not thirsty?
vocab.cn_example: 你记得带水了吗，这样你就不会口渴了？

vocab.definition: an opening in a building which lets in light
vocab.cn_meaning: 建筑物中让光线进入的开口
vocab.example: I can see trees through the window.
vocab.cn_example: 透过窗户我能看到树。

vocab.definition: before now
vocab.example: This is an example of a painting from long ago.
vocab.cn_example: 这是一幅很久以前的画的例子。

vocab.definition: to think the same thing

vocab.definition: in the direction pointing toward the bottom of a map
vocab.example: If you go south of the US, you will be in Mexico.
vocab.cn_example: 如果你从美国向南走，你就会到墨西哥。

vocab.definition: an open area in a town or city where people get together
vocab.cn_meaning: 城镇或城市中人们聚会的开放区域
vocab.example: Our favorite place in the city is this square.
vocab.cn_example: 我们在城市中最喜欢的地方是这个广场。

vocab.definition: a road, usually with buildings on one or both sides
vocab.cn_meaning: 一条路，通常一侧或两侧有建筑物
vocab.example: The street is not very busy at this time.
vocab.cn_example: 这条街在这个时间不是很繁忙。

vocab.definition: the night of today
vocab.example: Lori’s husband is working late tonight.
vocab.cn_example: 洛莉的丈夫今晚工作到很晚。

vocab.definition: a thing used to stop rain or the sun from getting on you
vocab.cn_meaning: 用来挡雨或遮阳的物品
vocab.example: They shared an umbrella to keep dry.
vocab.cn_example: 他们共用一把伞来保持干燥。
